requirement: The bundled test tools shall allow a local HTTP server to be started programmatically and provide its base URI for client access.

The proxy shall forward an inbound HTTP request, including its URI, headers, and body, to the upstream server once the upstream connection is ready, without requiring header or body transformation as part of forwarding.

The bundled test server shall support downloading an existing file as a binary attachment with its file name and return the handled file name after file upload processing. If the requested download file does not exist, it shall return neither a file attachment payload nor attachment metadata.

The bundled test client shall generate concurrent asynchronous HTTP GET workloads, report the total request count and the number of responses with HTTP status 200, and release its worker and HTTP-client resources after the workload completes.

The project shall support Maven multi-module builds using the declared compilation targets, including Java 1.8 for the root/test-server baseline and Java 1.7 for the proxy SDK module. The bundled test server shall use the Grizzly/Jersey stack with compatible declared dependencies.
When debug logging is enabled, the proxy shall provide diagnostic logging of the URI, headers, and body of the request being forwarded.
